title: Paying Courtesy Permit and Bus Pass Fees: Student Transportation Services Payment Terms
content:
**Rule.** Courtesy permit and bus pass fees of Student Transportation Services are paid by the accepted methods of the fee table (online card, ACH bank draft, personal check or money order) and are applied to the assignment's oldest open fee first. A payment applies only to the assignment the family names; a payment never moves to a sibling's assignment. Payment is not required on a fee fully offset by credits.

## Applied (hypothetical)

| Assignment's open fees, oldest first | Payment named to this assignment | Applied to |
|---|---|---|
| permit fee 67.50 open, replacement pass fee 5.00 open | 70.00 | 67.50 to the permit fee, then 2.50 to the pass fee |
| permit fee fully offset by a free-meal waiver credit | none | no payment is required |

## Points of judgement

- **A family with two riders pays toward one assignment.** The payment stays on the assignment named; it does not settle the sibling's fee.
- **Payment by a method outside the list (hypothetical).** Only online card, ACH bank draft, personal check and money order are accepted methods.
